Messages.Body:
Does strength/hand damage effect strikes that do damage but dont
specify that they are hand strikes? ie:corine marcon(+1 strength) and
fleshcraft (strike:1 damage...) ?

Would a tradiion:accounting (add 3 blood from bank to uncontrolled)
and a GTU superior (add 3 blood etc) count as the same action, and
thus fall under no repeat actions rule? [different action card, but
same action it would seem]

Is there no limit to the number of cardinals [like there is for
justicars/clan] you can benedict into creation, just the cap limit?

Thanks,
T

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Talonz51" <Talo...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:3bc61042.159683621@news...

>
> Does strength/hand damage effect strikes that do damage but dont
> specify that they are hand strikes?

No.

> ie:corine marcon(+1 strength) and
> fleshcraft (strike:1 damage...) ?

Fleshcraft does 1 damage. No more, no less.

> Would a tradiion:accounting (add 3 blood from bank to uncontrolled)
> and a GTU superior (add 3 blood etc) count as the same action, and
> thus fall under no repeat actions rule? [different action card, but
> same action it would seem]

They are different actions. They have the same effect, but as they effect
is not one of the defined actions types, it is not prohibited by the
tournament rule of "No Repeat Actions".

The only action types are listed in section 6.4.1 here:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknRules.html

Bleed
Hunt
Equip
Employ retainer
Recruit ally
Political action
Leave torpor
Rescue a vampire from torpor
Diablerize a vampire in torpor

> Is there no limit to the number of cardinals [like there is for
> justicars/clan] you can benedict into creation, just the cap limit?

Just the capacity limit.
All of the Sabbat vampires in play with a capacity
of 7 or higher may be cardinals.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

>> Bleed
>> Hunt
>> Equip

>> Political action
>> Leave torpor
>> Rescue a vampire from torpor
>> Diablerize a vampire in torpor
>>
>
>How about rescuing or diablerizing different vampires during the same turn? Or
>do the items basically get "crossed off" the above list after you take those
>specific actions during a turn?

You can, for instance, rescue a vampire, then freak drive, then
diablerise a vampire, then use Force of Will to bleed whilst tapped.

You cannot do anything on that list more than once and take it to
resolution (whether blocked or successful) with the same vampire in the
same turn.
